reviews.title: Issue: Video Recording Error Caused Recorded Files to Be Lost
reviews.text:
Hello,

I encountered a serious issue while using the app.

I was recording with both vertical and horizontal video modes at the same time. After recording for approximately 8 minutes, I tapped Stop Recording, but the app displayed an error message. After that, the recorded videos completely disappeared and were not saved.

I would like to ask:

1. Is there any way to recover the lost video files?
2. If recovery is not possible, please investigate and fix this issue so that users do not lose their recordings in the future.

I spent a lot of time recording this footage, so losing the entire video was very disappointing. I hope this issue can be resolved as soon as possible.
